projectDescription: The largest directory of private membership clubs in North America, offering search, comparison, and application tools for prospective members, plus lead generation and analytics for club membership directors — with a public REST API and MCP endpoint for AI integrations.
keyFeatures: Directory of 51,633+ private clubs across the US and Canada
Search and filter by location, club type, fees, and waitlist status
Side-by-side club comparison (initiation fees, dues, amenities, waitlists)
Direct membership application routing to membership directors
Membership Concierge service with dedicated advisor and money-back guarantee
Club profile claiming and verification for membership directors
Pre-qualified lead generation routed via email, SMS, WhatsApp, or CRM
AI discovery — club profiles surface in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini responses
Analytics dashboard: views, impressions, enquiries, and fee benchmarks
Verified members-only community requiring club affiliation confirmation
Public REST API with OpenAPI specification
Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint for AI tool integrations
15-language UI with fee display in 49 currencies
publicApiSurface: GET /ai/clubs.json — search and browse clubs (type, state, page, limit)
GET /llms-full.txt — full LLM reference with API docs and schemas
MCP tool: search_clubs (state, type, fee range, waitlist_status, query)
